# Project 3 – Wine Quality: Models + Graphics

- residual ~ predictor plots for each model  
- train vs validation RMSE for each model  

```{r sec0, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 0. Setup ----

# Install/load packages only if needed
pkgs <- c("broom", "dplyr", "readr", "car", "leaps", "MASS")
for (p in pkgs) {
  if (!require(p, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p)
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

set.seed(24)
```

```{r sec1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 1. Load data and split into train / validation ----

data <- read_csv("winequality-red.csv")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    quality_cat = case_when(
      quality <= 6 ~ "bad",
      quality >  6 ~ "good"
    )
  )

n <- nrow(data)
train_idx  <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.8 * n))
train_data <- data[train_idx, ]
valid_data <- data[-train_idx, ]
```

```{r sec2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 2. Helper functions ----

# Box–Cox-style transform for predictors
bc_transform <- function(x, lambda) {
  if (lambda == 0) return(log(x))
  (x ^ lambda - 1) / lambda
}

# Power transform for response (this matches how bc_alcohol was defined)
power_transform <- function(x, lambda) x ^ lambda

# Inverse of power transform
inv_power_transform <- function(y, lambda) {
  # guard against non-positive predictions (for negative lambda)
  y <- pmax(y, .Machine$double.eps)
  y ^ (1 / lambda)
}

# RMSE function
rmse <- function(actual, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Residual vs predictor plots (numeric -> scatter, categorical -> boxplot)
plot_resid_vs_predictors <- function(model_obj, data, model_name = "Model") {
  res <- residuals(model_obj)
  preds <- attr(terms(model_obj), "term.labels")
  # keep only predictors that are actual columns (drop interactions)
  preds <- preds[preds %in% names(data)]
  
  for (pred in preds) {
    x <- data[[pred]]
    
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      plot(
        x, res,
        main = paste(model_name, "- Residuals vs", pred),
        xlab = pred,
        ylab = "Residuals"
      )
      abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
    } else {
      boxplot(
        res ~ x,
        main = paste(model_name, "- Residuals vs", pred),
        xlab = pred,
        ylab = "Residuals"
      )
      abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
    }
  }
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}
```

```{r sec3, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 3. Baseline model: raw alcohol (call this model1 = 'model') ----

model <- lm(alcohol ~ . -quality, data = train_data)   # baseline
model1 <- update(model,.~. + `volatile acidity`*quality_cat )# alias for clarity

y_hat1 <- fitted(model1)
resid1 <- residuals(model1)

# Basic diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(
  y_hat1, train_data$alcohol,
  main = "Model1 (raw y): Actual vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted alcohol",
  ylab = "Actual alcohol"
)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lty = 2)

plot(
  y_hat1, resid1,
  main = "Model1 (raw y): Residuals vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted alcohol",
  ylab = "Residuals"
)
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

qqnorm(resid1, main = "Model1 (raw y): Q-Q plot")
qqline(resid1, col = "red")

# Residual vs predictor plots for Model1
plot_resid_vs_predictors(model1, train_data, "Model1 (raw y)")
```

```{r sec4, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 4. Transform response: bc_alcohol = alcohol^(-0.8) ----

lambda_alc <- -0.8
train_data$bc_alcohol <- power_transform(train_data$alcohol, lambda_alc)
bc_alcohol <- train_data$bc_alcohol   # keep vector name used later

# Show effect of response transformation
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(train_data$alcohol,
     main = "Alcohol (raw)", xlab = "alcohol")
hist(train_data$bc_alcohol,
     main = "Alcohol^(-0.8)", xlab = "bc_alcohol")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r sec5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

model2 <- update(model1, bc_alcohol ~ . - alcohol -quality)

)

plot(

  main = "Model2: Residuals vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted bc_alcohol",
  ylab = "Residuals"
)
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

qqnorm(resid2, main = "Model2: Q-Q plot (bc_alcohol)")

```

```{r sec6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 6. Model3: add residual sugar * chlorides interaction ----

model3 <- update(model2, . ~ . + `residual sugar` * chlorides)

anova(model2, model3)
BIC(model2, model3)

resid3 <- residuals(model3)
qqnorm(resid3, main = "Model3: Q-Q plot")
qqline(resid3, col = "red")

# Residual vs predictor plots for Model3
plot_resid_vs_predictors(model3, train_data, "Model3")
```

```{r sec7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 7. Transform key predictors (Box–Cox lambdas from bcPower) ----

# (You may already have run this at some point)
# summary(powerTransform(cbind(data[, c(4, 5, 6, 7, 10)])))

train_data$bc_residual_sugar <- bc_transform(train_data$`residual sugar`,      -1.19)
train_data$bc_chlorides      <- bc_transform(train_data$chlorides,             -0.50)
train_data$bc_free_SO2       <- bc_transform(train_data$`free sulfur dioxide`,  0.07)
train_data$bc_total_SO2      <- bc_transform(train_data$`total sulfur dioxide`, -0.08)
train_data$bc_sulphates      <- bc_transform(train_data$sulphates,             -1.00)

# Before vs after transformation for each X
par(mfrow = c(2, 5))
hist(train_data$`residual sugar`,
     main = "Residual sugar (raw)", xlab = "")
hist(train_data$bc_residual_sugar,
     main = "Residual sugar (BC)", xlab = "")

hist(train_data$chlorides,
     main = "Chlorides (raw)", xlab = "")
hist(train_data$bc_chlorides,
     main = "Chlorides (BC)", xlab = "")

hist(train_data$`free sulfur dioxide`,
     main = "Free SO2 (raw)", xlab = "")
hist(train_data$bc_free_SO2,
     main = "Free SO2 (BC)", xlab = "")

hist(train_data$`total sulfur dioxide`,
     main = "Total SO2 (raw)", xlab = "")
hist(train_data$bc_total_SO2,
     main = "Total SO2 (BC)", xlab = "")

hist(train_data$sulphates,
     main = "Sulphates (raw)", xlab = "")
hist(train_data$bc_sulphates,
     main = "Sulphates (BC)", xlab = "")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r sec8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 8. Model4: use BC-transformed Xs instead of raw Xs ----

model4 <- update(
  model2,
  . ~ .
  - `residual sugar`
  - chlorides
  - `free sulfur dioxide`
  - `total sulfur dioxide`
  - sulphates
  + bc_residual_sugar
  + bc_chlorides
  + bc_free_SO2
  + bc_total_SO2
  + bc_sulphates,
  data = train_data
)

y_hat4 <- fitted(model4)
resid4 <- residuals(model4)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(
  y_hat4, bc_alcohol,
  main = "Model4: Actual vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted bc_alcohol",
  ylab = "Actual bc_alcohol"
)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lty = 2)

plot(
  y_hat4, resid4,
  main = "Model4: Residuals vs Fitted",
  xlab = "Fitted bc_alcohol",
  ylab = "Residuals"
)
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
qqnorm(resid4, main = "Model4: Q-Q (y & X transformed)")
qqline(resid4, col = "red")
qqnorm(resid2, main = "Model2: Q-Q (only y transformed)")
qqline(resid2, col = "red")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Residual vs predictor plots for Model4
plot_resid_vs_predictors(model4, train_data, "Model4")
```

```{r sec9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 9. Model5: drop bc_chlorides and bc_total_SO2 ----

model5 <- update(model4, . ~ . - bc_chlorides - bc_total_SO2)
anova(model5, model4)

resid5 <- residuals(model5)
qqnorm(resid5, main = "Model5: Q-Q plot")
qqline(resid5, col = "red")

# Residual vs predictor plots for Model5
plot_resid_vs_predictors(model5, train_data, "Model5")
```

```{r sec10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 10. Best subset selection from Model4 structure ----

p_mod4 <- length(attr(terms(model4), "term.labels"))

reg_fit <- regsubsets(
  formula(model4),
  data   = train_data,
  nvmax  = p_mod4,
  method = "exhaustive"
)

reg_summary <- summary(reg_fit)

model_size <- 1:p_mod4
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(model_size, reg_summary$adjr2, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of predictors", ylab = "Adjusted R^2",
     main = "Best subsets: Adjusted R^2")
plot(model_size, reg_summary$bic, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of predictors", ylab = "BIC",
     main = "Best subsets: BIC")
plot(model_size, reg_summary$cp, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of predictors", ylab = "Cp",
     main = "Best subsets: Cp")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# reg_summary$outmat  # table of selected variables (printed if needed)
```

```{r sec11, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 11. Model6: final chosen model (from regsubsets) ----

model6 <- lm(
  bc_alcohol ~
    `fixed acidity` +
```

```{r sec12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 12. Model7: stepwise alternative from Model4 ----

model7 <- lm(
  bc_alcohol ~ `fixed acidity` + `volatile acidity` +
    `citric acid` + density + pH + quality_cat +
    bc_residual_sugar + bc_total_SO2 + bc_sulphates +
    `volatile acidity` : quality_cat,
  data = train_data
)

summary(model7)

criteria_model6 <- c(
  adjR2 = summary(model6)$adj.r.squared,
  AIC   = extractAIC(model6, k = 2)[2],
  BIC   = extractAIC(model6, k = log(nrow(train_data)))[2]
)
criteria_model7 <- c(
  adjR2 = summary(model7)$adj.r.squared,
  AIC   = extractAIC(model7, k = 2)[2],
  BIC   = extractAIC(model7, k = log(nrow(train_data)))[2]
)
criteria_model6
criteria_model7

# Residual vs predictor plots for Model7
plot_resid_vs_predictors(model7, train_data, "Model7")
```

```{r sec13, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 13. Influence diagnostics for Model6 (optional, kept for completeness) ----

n_train <- nrow(train_data)
p_mod6  <- length(coef(model6))

hii        <- hatvalues(model6)
cutoff_hii <- 2 * p_mod6 / n_train

ri <- rstandard(model6)

di        <- cooks.distance(model6)
cutoff_di <- qf(0.5, p_mod6, n_train - p_mod6)

dffits_val    <- dffits(model6)
cutoff_dffits <- 2 * sqrt(p_mod6 / n_train)

dfbetas_val    <- dfbetas(model6)
cutoff_dfbetas <- 2 / sqrt(n_train)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(hii, main = "Model6: Leverage (h_ii)", ylab = "h_ii")
abline(h = cutoff_hii, col = "red", lty = 2)

plot(ri, main = "Model6: Standardized residuals", ylab = "r_i")
abline(h = c(-2, 2), col = "red", lty = 2)

plot(di, main = "Model6: Cook's distance", ylab = "D_i")
abline(h = cutoff_di, col = "red", lty = 2)

plot(dffits_val, main = "Model6: DFFITS", ylab = "DFFITS_i")
abline(h = c(-cutoff_dffits, cutoff_dffits), col = "red", lty = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# DFBETAS influence by coefficient (printed if you want to inspect)
for (j in 1:p_mod6) {
  cat("Beta", j - 1, "\n")
  print(which(abs(dfbetas_val[, j]) > cutoff_dfbetas))
}
```

```{r sec14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 14. Mirror transformations on VALIDATION data ----

valid_data$bc_residual_sugar <- bc_transform(valid_data$`residual sugar`,      -1.19)
valid_data$bc_chlorides      <- bc_transform(valid_data$chlorides,             -0.50)
valid_data$bc_free_SO2       <- bc_transform(valid_data$`free sulfur dioxide`,  0.07)
valid_data$bc_total_SO2      <- bc_transform(valid_data$`total sulfur dioxide`, -0.08)
valid_data$bc_sulphates      <- bc_transform(valid_data$sulphates,             -1.00)

# For models with transformed response
valid_data$bc_alcohol <- power_transform(valid_data$alcohol, lambda_alc)
```

```{r sec15, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 15. Train vs validation RMSE for all models ----

# 1) Model1 (raw y)
pred1_train <- predict(model1, newdata = train_data)
pred1_valid <- predict(model1, newdata = valid_data)

rmse1_train <- rmse(train_data$alcohol, pred1_train)
rmse1_valid <- rmse(valid_data$alcohol, pred1_valid)

# 2) Models with bc_alcohol response: 2–7
models_bc <- list(
  Model2 = model2,
  Model3 = model3,
  Model4 = model4,
  Model5 = model5,
  Model6 = model6,
  Model7 = model7
)

rmse_train_vec <- numeric(length(models_bc))
rmse_valid_vec <- numeric(length(models_bc))

i <- 1
for (nm in names(models_bc)) {
  m <- models_bc[[nm]]
  
  pred_bc_train <- predict(m, newdata = train_data)
  pred_bc_valid <- predict(m, newdata = valid_data)
  
  pred_alc_train <- inv_power_transform(pred_bc_train, lambda_alc)
  pred_alc_valid <- inv_power_transform(pred_bc_valid, lambda_alc)
  
  rmse_train_vec[i] <- rmse(train_data$alcohol, pred_alc_train)
  rmse_valid_vec[i] <- rmse(valid_data$alcohol, pred_alc_valid)
  
  i <- i + 1
}

rmse_df <- data.frame(
  Model       = c("Model1", names(models_bc)),
  RMSE_Train  = c(rmse1_train, rmse_train_vec),
  RMSE_Valid  = c(rmse1_valid, rmse_valid_vec)
)

print(rmse_df)
```

```{r sec16, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---- 16. Final graphical comparison: validation RMSE by model ----
cols <- c("bc_alcohol",          "bc_residual_sugar",     "bc_chlorides",         
          "bc_free_SO2",           "bc_total_SO2",         "bc_sulphates", 
          "fixed acidity",         "volatile acidity" ,     "citric acid" ,
          "density")
pairs(train_data[, cols], 
      main = "Pairwise plots of transformem/raw variables")

i <- 1
for (nm in names(models_bc)) {
  m <- models_bc[[nm]]
  
  # predictions on transformed scale
  pred_bc_train <- predict(m, newdata = train_data)
  pred_bc_valid <- predict(m, newdata = valid_data)
  
  # back-transform to original alcohol scale
  pred_alc_train <- inv_power_transform(pred_bc_train, lambda_alc)
  pred_alc_valid <- inv_power_transform(pred_bc_valid, lambda_alc)
  
  rmse_train_vec[i] <- rmse(train_data$alcohol, pred_alc_train)
  rmse_valid_vec[i] <- rmse(valid_data$alcohol, pred_alc_valid)
  
  i <- i + 1
}

## Combine all RMSEs in one data frame
rmse_df <- data.frame(
  Model      = c("Model1", names(models_bc)),
  RMSE_Train = c(rmse1_train, rmse_train_vec),
  RMSE_Valid = c(rmse1_valid, rmse_valid_vec)
)

print(rmse_df)

## Create a grouped barplot: for EACH MODEL, show Train vs Validation RMSE
rmse_matrix <- rbind(rmse_df$RMSE_Train, rmse_df$RMSE_Valid)
rownames(rmse_matrix) <- c("Training", "Validation")

barplot(
  rmse_matrix,
  beside    = TRUE,
  names.arg = rmse_df$Model,
  main      = "RMSE by Model and Dataset",
  ylab      = "RMSE (original alcohol scale)",
  legend.text = rownames(rmse_matrix),
  args.legend = list(
    x     = "topright",
    inset = c(-0.02, -0.14),  # move left and down a bit
    bty   = "n"
  ),
  las       = 3
)

```
